name: Desperate Prayer
summary: In Stormwind, dwarven priests are called to deepen their service to the Light. High Priestess Laurena summons promising acolytes from Dun Morogh to the Cathedral of Light. There they take on wider duties among the Alliance.

sections.title: A Summons to the Cathedral
sections.body: Dwarven priests trained in Dun Morogh can outgrow the lessons of local mentors like Maxan Anvol in Kharanos. When an acolyte shows promise, High Priestess Laurena sends a formal summons from the Cathedral of Light. Her attention means the young priest is ready for deeper study and greater duties in the faith.

sections.title: Bonds Across Kingdoms
sections.body: Ironforge keeps its own holy traditions in the Mystic Ward, while Stormwind's Church of the Holy Light welcomes humans and dwarves alike. The journey south by Deeprun Tram brings dwarven acolytes into the wider church community and strengthens the spiritual bond between the allied kingdoms.

faq.q: Why is High Priestess Laurena calling dwarven priests to Stormwind?
faq.answer: High Priestess Laurena calls promising acolytes to continue their religious instruction at the Cathedral of Light. Local tutors such as Maxan Anvol send them when they have mastered the basic tenets, so they can learn advanced techniques like Desperate Prayer.

faq.q: What is Desperate Prayer in the lore?
faq.answer: Desperate Prayer is an urgent appeal to the Holy Light practiced by human and dwarven clerics. When a priest is near death, a sudden cry of faith knits wounds and restores vitality.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You begin in Kharanos in Dun Morogh, where Maxan Anvol teaches you. From there, you travel to Stormwind City and the Cathedral of Light in Cathedral Square, where High Priestess Laurena presides.

faq.q: Why would a dwarf priest train under a human High Priestess?
faq.answer: Dwarves and humans share faith in the Holy Light, a bond strengthened during the Second War. Dwarven priests often serve in Ironforge's Mystic Ward, while Stormwind's Cathedral of Light welcomes practitioners from across the Alliance.

faq.q: How should a young traveler reach Stormwind from Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: Travel through Ironforge's Tinker Town and take the Deeprun Tram beneath the mountains to Stormwind's Dwarven District.
Maxan Anvol is a dwarven priest trainer in Kharanos, Dun Morogh. He teaches young clerics the fundamentals until they are ready to study with senior church leaders in Stormwind.

angles.text: As a priest, you move from basic duties in your parish to advanced holy techniques taught by the Church's leaders.
As a dwarf, your journey to Stormwind's Cathedral strengthens the spiritual bond between Ironforge and the human realm of Stormwind.
As an Alliance member, you share the Light with practitioners from Ironforge and Stormwind, united across racial borders.
